sources.evidence_extract: Title 'PMEG4010CEJ 40 V, 1 A very low VF Schottky barrier rectifier', 1 October 2022, Product data sheet. SOD323F (SC-90) package. Table 1: IF 1 A max (Tsp<=55 C); VR 40 V max; VF typ 490 / max 570 mV at IF=1000 mA, tp<=300 us, delta<=0.02, Tamb=25 C. Footer: 'All information provided in this document is subject to legal disclaimers. (c) Nexperia B.V. 2022. All rights reserved'. Table 2: pin 1 K cathode (marking bar indicates the cathode), pin 2 A anode. Text layer extracted with pdf.js 4.4.168 in the browser.

sources.document_title: PMEG4010CEJ 40 V, 1 A very low VF Schottky barrier rectifier, Product data sheet
sources.locator: page 2: Table 3 Ordering information, Table 4 Marking codes, Table 5 Limiting values, Table 6 Thermal characteristics
sources.evidence_extract: Table 3: type number PMEG4010CEJ, package SC-90, 'plastic, surface-mounted package; 2 leads; 1.7 mm x 1.25 mm x 0.7 mm body', version SOD323F. Table 4: marking code EP. Table 5 (IEC 60134): VR 40 V; IF 1 A (Tsp<=55 C); IFRM 7 A (tp<=1 ms, delta<=0.25); IFSM 10 A (tp=8 ms square wave, Tj(init)=25 C); Ptot 350 mW [1] / 830 mW [2] at Tamb<=25 C; Tj 150 C max; Tamb -65..150 C; Tstg -65..150 C. Table 6: Rth(j-a) 350 K/W [1][2] / 150 K/W [1][3]; Rth(j-sp) 55 K/W. Note [1]: for Schottky barrier diodes thermal runaway has to be considered, as reverse power losses can be a significant part of total losses. Text layer extracted with pdf.js 4.4.168 in the browser.
